title: Tropical cyclone forecast discussion (NHC)
description: An NHC forecast discussion for a fictional storm, followed by the forecast positions and maximum winds. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

examples: NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL AL042026

examples: Satellite images show Marlena has a well-defined eye. The initial intensity is set at 85 kt, based on Air Force reconnaissance data. Warm water and low shear favor additional strengthening before landfall.

examples.heading: GUIDANCE
examples.text: The track models are tightly clustered and the forecast follows the consensus toward the northern Gulf coast. The risk of storm surge is high near and east of the center.
